intro.title: One Connected System for Every Channel
paragraphs: Today's shoppers browse online, buy in store, return via courier and expect the same prices and loyalty points everywhere. Retailers running separate POS, inventory and online systems struggle with stock mismatches, lost sales and customers who feel like strangers in every channel.

We build retail software that connects it all: POS and billing, multi-store and warehouse inventory, loyalty and rewards, retail mobile apps, ecommerce storefronts and analytics. Every sale, return and stock movement updates instantly, so your teams and customers always see the truth.

We work with single-brand stores, retail chains, D2C brands and distributors. Selling mainly online? See our <eco>ecommerce software development</eco> services, browse <work>retail projects</work> or <contact>talk to us about your stores</contact>.

faqs.title: Retail Software Development FAQs
faqs.subtitle: Quick answers for retailers and D2C brands.

items.a: It is building software for retailers, such as POS and billing, inventory, loyalty, mobile apps, ecommerce and analytics, connected so every channel shares the same data.

items.q: Can you connect our stores and online store inventory?
items.a: Yes. We build omnichannel inventory that syncs stock across stores, warehouses, your online store and marketplaces in real time.
Yes. Our POS keeps billing during internet outages and syncs sales and stock automatically when the connection returns.

items.q: Can you build a loyalty programme?
items.a: Yes. We build points, tiers, coupons and referral programmes that customers can use in store, online and in your app.

items.q: How much does retail software cost?
items.a: Store POS and inventory typically costs $5,000 to $15,000, an omnichannel retail system $15,000 to $60,000, and retail chain platforms $60,000 or more.

items.q: What is the difference between this and ecommerce development?
items.a: Retail software connects physical stores, inventory and online channels. Ecommerce development focuses on online stores and apps. We can build either or both together.
